queries.query: Pakistan official Khanpur Punjab cadastral land records map parcel GIS
queries.result: Found the official Punjab Urban Land Systems Enhancement (PULSE) GIS portal and Punjab Land Records Authority (PLRA). PULSE describes a parcel map linked to provincial land records; the public viewer exposes a Rahim Yar Khan cadastral layer through ArcGIS REST.

queries.query: site:punjab-zameen.gov.pk خانپور اراضی ریکارڈ نقشہ کادستر
queries.result: Found the official Urdu/English PLRA Registry of Deeds login portal and Punjab land-record service references. The result is a login/CAPTCHA-gated records service, not an anonymous parcel-geometry endpoint; no login or CAPTCHA interaction was attempted.

registry.provider: Punjab Urban Land Systems Enhancement (PULSE), Punjab Land Records Authority / Government of Punjab
registry.custody: Punjab provincial cadastral/land-record mapping service; the inspected layer is Rahim Yar Khan district, which contains Khanpur.
registry.evidence: The official PULSE viewer configuration names Punjab_Cdastral_Maps and its Rahim Yar Khan layer; the official PULSE site states that it provides GIS mapping of parcels linked to Punjab land records.

parcelEvidence.sampleQualification: Three polygons returned by the official layer for the bounded extent; they are not asserted to contain the exact WUP point.
